findings.defect: “This year’s” adds a yearly timeframe that the Korean does not establish; “이번” refers to this hunt or the current occasion.
findings.rationale: The source says “이번 맹수 토벌” (“this/current ferocious-beast hunt”), not “this year’s hunt.”

findings.current: There’s no reason for Nanman to concern itself with affairs in the Central Plains. None at all.
findings.defect: The added “None at all” replaces the source’s qualification “at least us in Nanman,” changing the scope and emphasis of Baeksang’s statement.
findings.rationale: The Korean closes with “적어도 우리 남만은” (“at least, we in Nanman”), contrasting Nanman with the Central Plains rather than restating that there is no reason at all.
findings.replacement: There’s no reason for Nanman to concern itself with affairs in the Central Plains. At least, not for us in Nanman.

findings.defect: The translation drops the source’s image of a vast, boundless sea, which the accepted baseline preserves.
findings.rationale: “드넓은 망망대해” explicitly describes an immense, boundless expanse of sea.

findings.current: An immense wave of qi bore down on me from every direction, squeezing my entire body.
findings.defect: “Bore down” adds a downward direction not present in the source; the pressure is described as constricting his whole body from all sides.
findings.rationale: “사방에서” establishes pressure coming from every direction, and “옥죄어 오는” describes it closing in or constricting; no downward force is specified.
findings.replacement: An immense wave of qi pressed in on me from every direction, squeezing my entire body.
findings.source: Korean line 353: “사방에서 전신을 옥죄어 오는 거대한 기파”

summary: The assembled translation is largely faithful, but it adds a time frame, shifts the scope of Baeksang’s claim, and alters a couple of physical or geographic details.
